//: Story Phase 8, chapters 45 to 47: nobody will hold the sash, so the Grand Stenchmaster decides the problem is presentation. The costume trunk; a dented cork sun-helmet on Barnacle Bob (PROFESSOR BARNACLE BOB, explorer of gastrointestinal mysteries; he wants no part of it); the Grand Stenchmaster's Grand Crown (Grand twice; Jim's cutlery; brass off the bilge pump); THE GRAND EXPEDITION FOR THE LOST FART, hidden in the Temple of the Grand Stenchmaster ('Your stomach.' 'Ancient chamber.'); 'Lore does not make it better.' The landmarks are all in the room. Then the captain hands Squawks to Gristle (Stinkbeard angry. Very.): FART SASH / STENCHMASTER SASH, three weeks old, its 'history'. Then a yawn: the GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND NAP; a fart blanket; everyone says it, even Squawks; the biggest rumble yet ('Was that the Lost Fart?' '...Maybe.'); the nap is banned. Everything Garrick says here is Garrick making it up, and everyone knows it.

p8c4.begin.sub: The Grand Expedition for the Lost Fart

p8c4.begin: The Grand Stenchmaster goes quiet. He's thinking again, which is worse than talking.
Then he gets up, crosses the hold, and opens the ship's costume trunk.
garrick[businesslike]: The problem, gentlemen, is presentation.
garrick[businesslike]: I made it sound like WORK. Nobody wants to do work.
garrick[delighted]: So we shan't. We shall have an ADVENTURE.

p8c4.begin.tutorial: See what he's dragging out of the costume trunk (next to his chair).
p8c4.begin.title: The Lost Fart Expedition

p8c4.trunk: The costume trunk, from the years when the crew put on a play every Midsummer. The Grand Stenchmaster is in it up to the elbows.
Out come: a wooden sword, a feather, a moth, a long knitted scarf, and a cork sun-helmet with a dent in the top and a patch on the dent.
Before anyone can stop him, he crosses the hold and puts the helmet on Barnacle Bob. Then he winds the scarf round Bob's neck, twice.
garrick[proud]: Behold. PROFESSOR BARNACLE BOB. Legendary explorer of gastrointestinal mysteries.
bob: I'm not modest, I'm saying NO.
bob: It does NOT suit me.

p8c4.trunk.tutorial: And now he's putting something on his own head. Look at it (him). If you must.
p8c4.trunk.title: The Lost Fart Expedition

p8c4.crown: garrick[proud]: And for the Grand Stenchmaster himself...
He reaches back into the trunk, takes out something that clanks, and lowers it onto his head with both hands.

p8c4.crown.caption: On his head. In the lantern light. Clanking.

p8c4.crown: garrick[proud]: The Grand Stenchmaster's Grand Crown.
jim[angry]: And my forks! And— is that my SAUCEPAN?
garrick[businesslike]: The topper. It's the topper now.
captain[annoyed]: It isn't gold. It's brass. That's the handle off the bilge pump. And the bell's clapper.

p8c4.crown.tutorial: He wants to explain the adventure. Hear the premise (him), if you must.
p8c4.crown.title: The Lost Fart Expedition

p8c4.premise: garrick[proud]: Gather round. This is the tale of the GRAND EXPEDITION FOR THE LOST FART.
garrick[proud]: Long ago, deep in the lost realm of Reekhollow, there stood a temple. The Temple of the Grand Stenchmaster.
garrick[proud]: And within it, sealed in its deepest chamber, the most powerful wind ever released. Or rather, NOT yet released. The Lost Fart.
garrick[proud]: The brave explorer must journey into the temple, find the Lost Fart, and at the moment of its release, hold the sacred sash aloft, so that it is not—
garrick[businesslike]: —so that it comes to no harm.
pete[annoyed]: It's the same thing. It's the exact same thing. Hold the sash while you fart.
garrick[offended]: It is NOT the same thing. It has LORE.
pete[annoyed]: Lore does not make it better.

p8c5.begin.sub: The Legend of the Lost Fart

p8c5.begin: The Grand Stenchmaster will not let it go. He stands on his rug, crown on, and points around the hold as he goes, like a man giving a tour.
garrick[proud]: The temple has its chambers, gentlemen. Its ancient landmarks. The explorer must pass them all.
captain[tired]: They're all in this room, aren't they.

p8c5.begin.tutorial: His 'ancient landmarks' are all in this room. Go and see what they really are: the reserve casks (by Bob), Mark II, and the wet patch by the pump.
p8c5.begin.title: The Lost Fart Expedition

p8c5.grog: garrick[proud]: First, the explorer must cross the CHAMBER OF FROG GROG, where the ancient brew bubbles in its sacred vessels!
It's the three casks and a bit. One of them is leaking on Bob, who is still wearing the helmet.
bob[disgusted]: The sacred vessel is in my ear.
mags[annoyed]: It's my BREWING, Garrick. It's not sacred. It's barely legal.
From the blankets in your corner:
p8c5.oracle: garrick[proud]: Then, the ELECTRIC FROG ORACLE, which speaks only in riddles!
It's Mark II. It goes ZZZT. On the screen, the Auditor is holding up a leaf.
p8c5.ravine: garrick[proud]: And the BOTTOMLESS RAVINE, from which no explorer has ever returned!
It's a damp patch of floor by the pump, about six inches across, where Pete spilled his grog last night.
pete[annoyed]: I didn't spill it. It escaped.
You step over the Bottomless Ravine.
Everybody looks at the chair. The Grand Stenchmaster looks at his stomach. Nothing happens. Everybody looks away again.

then: garrick[proud]: And so the explorer, having braved the Chamber, consulted the Oracle and leapt the Ravine, stands before the Lost Fart itself, sash in hand—
You feel something go, quietly, somewhere behind your eyes. It is your patience.

then.tutorial: That's enough. Hand Squawks to Gristle.
then.title: The Lost Fart Expedition

p8c5.snap: You lift Squawks out of his blankets, very gently, and hand him to Gristle.
The hold goes quiet. Everyone aboard knows what it means when the captain puts the parrot down.
captain[angry]: The ship is half eaten.
captain[angry]: The crew haven't slept in a day and a half.
captain[angry]: The treasure is ruined. My BEARD is ruined.
captain[angry]: There's a storm made of SHARKS sitting on the roof, and every one of us is shut in a box at the bottom of the ship with YOU...
captain[angry]: ...and ye want us to hold your FART SASH.
pete: We're arguing about vocabulary. In a shark cyclone.
garrick[proud]: This sash has a NOBLE HISTORY, Captain.
captain[angry]: What has it actually DONE?
garrick[proud]: It led the first Grand Stenchmaster Parade.
garrick[proud]: It presided over the Frog Grog ceremony.
garrick[proud]: It was THERE, Captain, for the second major Stench event.
captain[angry]: That is the MOST fart-sash thing ye've ever said.
garrick[proud]: And it has survived the Great Sharkstorm. So far.
captain[angry]: So have the BISCUITS. Barely.
p8c6.begin: And then, right in the middle of it all, the Grand Stenchmaster yawns.
An enormous yawn. All the fight goes out of him at once, like air out of a sail.
garrick[happy]: Gentlemen. It is nearly time.
garrick[proud]: The GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND NAP.
gristle[annoyed]: He's found one adjective and he's going to ride it into the ground.
garrick[businesslike]: It is an ancient Stenchmaster tradition.
captain[angry]: There ARE no ancient Stenchmaster traditions, Garrick. There's YOU.
garrick[businesslike]: The preparations are traditional. The lanterns are dimmed. A little Frog Grog is taken. The ceremonial pillows are fluffed. The sash is laid nearby.
Every word of this is being invented as he says it. You can see him doing it.
p8c6.blanket: Gristle hands Squawks back. Squawks climbs straight into your coat and turns round so he can see.
captain: So the sash is important. During the nap.
captain[smug]: Would ye like to use it as a blanket? Your precious FART SASH?
The hold erupts. Rook has to lie down.
A small voice, from inside your coat.
He looks more hurt by that than by anything else that has happened today. Including the storm.
And his stomach unleashes the biggest rumble of the day.
Dust comes down out of the deckhead in sheets. Mark II's picture jumps. Every lantern swings.
captain[angry]: No napping. Grand or otherwise. Not until ye KNOW whether ye're about to kill us all.
garrick[nervous]: I still can't tell, Captain.
pete[annoyed]: THAT IS NOT GOOD ENOUGH.
